description: Ireland: the Mortgage Interest Tax Credit for 2023-2026: 20% of the increase in mortgage interest over 2022, capped at EUR 1,250 a year for 2023-2025 and EUR 625 for 2026 (50% of the increase), for a home loan with a balance between EUR 80,000 and EUR 500,000 on 31 December 2022; each year with its last date to claim (four-year rule).
